raw_response:
*Sitting down, thinking out loud...*

Ai, I'm 70 now, been working this land forty years. Just me and the old lady at home — the boy's in the city, doesn't come back except at Spring Festival. We got this little 2.6 mu, that's all. Not enough to get rich, enough to keep us eating.

I do what I've always done. Wheat in October, maize after wheat comes off in June. Same as everyone in the village. At my age I'm not going to try anything clever — Old Wang next to me switched to some fancy variety two years back and half his wheat froze out, served him right.

**Wheat.** I'll plant around October 10th, same as always, whenever the soil feels right after the maize is off. Seed I get from Old Wang, he saves his own — cheaper than the shop, and it's worked fine for us. Before I plant I'll put down a couple bags of compound fertilizer (the 15-15-15 kind, about two bags for the whole plot), and then come March when the wheat is greening up I'll broadcast one bag of urea. My son drives it out in the truck when he visits — I can't haul fertilizer anymore, my back's gone.

Water it three times — once before the freeze to settle it in, once at greening, once at jointing when the heads are forming. Well is close by but the electric meter ticks fast, can't go overboard. Spray a little herbicide for the grass weeds, that's all. Harvest with the combine in early June — 70 yuan per mu, the driver comes through the village.

I figure maybe 800 jin per mu if the weather's ordinary. Last year was 780, year before 820.

**Maize.** Right after the combine goes through in June, I hire the young fellow with the tractor to direct-seed the maize into the wheat stubble — no time to plow, and I can't do that work anymore anyway. Buy the seed at the shop in town, same brand as the last few years, Zhengdan something, 50 yuan a bag will seed my plot. One bag of compound at planting, and when it's knee-high I sidedress some urea.

If it rains good in July and August I might not irrigate at all. If it's dry I'll water once or twice. Bollworm sometimes gets bad, I'll spray once if I see them. Harvest end of September, combine again.

Expect maybe 900 jin per mu, that's a normal year for me.

**Money.** I try not to spend more than two thousand and a bit on inputs for the year. The pension helps a little, and the grain subsidy. Anything leftover from selling the grain goes in the jar for medicine and Spring Festival.
